General information only — not medical advice. Consult a professional for personal guidance. Ease into standing gradually if you are new to it.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your total work hours for the day.
  2. Pick a sit:stand ratio.
  3. Set your day's start time.
  4. Press Build schedule and follow the alternating blocks.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How much standing is healthy?

Common guidance suggests standing or moving for 2–4 hours of an 8-hour day, changing posture every 30–60 minutes.

Should I stand all at once?

Alternate blocks (e.g. 40 min sitting, 20 min standing) rather than one long stand — variety matters more than totals.

Can I set my own start time?

Yes — the table uses 24-hour clock times starting from whatever start time you enter.
